blockers.finding: The pinned February 3, 2022 snapshot postdates every January decision. Per-row original publication/first-seen timestamps are absent. The Dolt log time has no UTC offset. Current acquisition times cannot be backdated to bar closes.
blockers.resolution: Obtain verified decision-admissible source vintages and timestamp semantics for the warmup and evaluation rows, or start a separately frozen prospective diagnostic with observed receipt timestamps.

blockers.finding: Zero dividend and split rows are a provider observation, not a complete action ledger. No independent interval-wide reconciliation of cash/stock actions, renames, class continuity, exits and terminal proceeds was completed. Prior audit found a real omitted DDS dividend outside this twelve-name scope.
blockers.resolution: Reconcile all twelve classes across the full warmup/evaluation interval against primary action notices; retain confirmed no-action findings and receipt/pay dates.

blockers.finding: Vendor raw-versus-adjusted OHLC convention and an as-of total-return momentum index are unverified. Coherent OHLC does not establish either.
blockers.resolution: Document upstream price adjustment conventions and construct a causal total-return series from the reconciled action ledger without future adjustments.

blockers.finding: SEC covers establish common-stock classification at twelve filing dates, not permanent class IDs or complete exchange eligibility intervals. CIK identifies a filer.
blockers.resolution: Assign documented class-level IDs and verify listing/class continuity, including any exits; do not treat ticker strings or CIKs as permanent security IDs.

blockers.finding: This is a deliberately narrow, retrospectively named twelve-stock diagnostic, not a point-in-time census or a survivorship-neutral NYSE sample.
blockers.resolution: Keep the fixed scope and claims narrow. A later broad-universe confirmation needs independently frozen point-in-time membership and delisted securities.

blockers.finding: Daily OHLCV provides no order-time bid/ask, quote size, auction eligibility or halt state. ATR and raw opens are not executable quotes.
blockers.resolution: After admissible signals freeze intended whole-share orders, verify the relevant following-session quotes/auction data, sizes and halts; retain unfilled orders.

blockers.finding: Public access does not establish upstream market-data redistribution rights; no new license approval is claimed.
blockers.resolution: Verify upstream provider terms before redistribution or deployment. Raw market files remain outside Git.
